label: copy-phase re-fed x, esp. doubled xx in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input token is x (the model feeding back an x it just output): 100% of dev activations have in_tok = x. It is very sparse even inside that set (288 of ~90k copy-phase x inputs), so precision is low. Activation is concentrated where the next output is also x (doubled xx in the original, 71% of mass), at recall_idx >= 4 (98% of mass), and in long sequences (L = 9 holds 76% of mass). The top activations are the first x of an xx pair at original positions 3-5 of 9-token sequences (e.g. 3 2 q l x x ...). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, on non-x inputs, or for L <= 4. Many inputs that meet all these conditions still do not activate, so the full gating condition is not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=x (+6.48), phase=2 & out_tok=x (+3.65), prev_tok=l (+2.67), orig8=t (+1.88), phase=2 & out_tok=a (+1.88), phase=2 & out_tok=o (+1.69).
